title: packages: `PATCH /api/v1/packages/:id` edits a read-only package's manifest (200), where disable, publish, revert, delete and install-overwrite refuse it `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`
body:
Filing gate **①: a defect with a named locus and a measured reach.** Reader who acts: the `domain:cli` seat (`packages/runtime`), triage first for the grade. Filed by `domain:cli` seat 2 (#22648) · `os-justin` · session `session_01LmjU2x1faLZ39DVTFyVca6`, from out-of-scope finding 2 of the dev report on #24670 (PR #24703). The seat moved it out of that PR rather than fixing it there. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Measured

- **Reach:** a one-off probe through the dispatcher (`handlePackagesRequest`) over a real `SchemaRegistry`, on a package whose manifest declares `scope: 'system'`:
  - `PATCH /api/v1/packages/:id` with `{ "description": "…" }` answers `200` and edits the manifest.
  - With PR #24703, `{ "dependencies": { … } }` answers `200` too.
  - `PATCH /api/v1/packages/:id/disable` on the same package answers `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`.
  - The probe was not committed. The dev's report on #24670 records it as `class: a`.
- **Locus** (read on `origin/main` `d1173825b`): `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, the `PATCH /packages/:id` arm.
  - It calls `requireManageMetadata` and `refuseWalledCatalogPackageWrite`, and nothing else.
  - Every other state-changing arm on the same domain also calls `requireWritablePackage`: install-overwrite (`:1410`), disable (`:1602`), publish (`:1629`), revert (`:2114`) and delete (`:2309`).
  - That function's refusal says, verbatim: "it is read-only (provided by code or an installed app). Packages the deployment ships are managed by the deployment, not over this API".
- **Governing text:** ADR-0070 (`docs/adr/0070-package-first-authoring.md`), which the refusal's `docs` field names, and ADR-0131 D6 (the customise-beside remedy). The manifest of a package the deployment ships is managed by the deployment. The PATCH arm is the one state-changing `/packages` arm that edits it over this API.
- **Persistence:** on a host with the `package` service, `protocol.updatePackage` re-persists the edited manifest to `sys_packages`. NOT measured: what a code package's stored row does on the next boot.

## Shape (not decided here)

Gate the whole arm with `requireWritablePackage` before the body is read, as its siblings do. This applies to all four keys (`name`, `description`, `version`, `dependencies`). It is a narrowing of the door, so it owes the contract-review-tier review before the queue and a `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` changeset.

Pins:
- a read-only package's PATCH answers `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` with nothing written to the registry or `sys_packages`;
- a writable package's PATCH is unchanged.

## Dedupe

Semantic issue search on `objectstack-ai/objectstack` for `PATCH packages manifest edit read-only package WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED requireWritablePackage not gated`, closed cards included: 23 hits, the top 15 read. The nearest are #24030 (closed, the install-overwrite door's gate), #24062 (closed, an authored install declaring `scope: system`) and #7682 (closed). None names the PATCH arm.
